name: PunisherBanna
overview: Zufällige Filme und Serien als Banner auf der Jellyfin-Startseite.
description: Zeigt zufällige Filme oder Serien aus einer ausgewählten Bibliothek als anklickbaren Banner-Slider an.

versions.changelog: Fixes primary-button navigation at the pointer-event level. Releasing the left mouse button after a normal banner press now opens the owning series or movie directly, without waiting for a browser-generated click that may be suppressed by pointer capture. Genuine drag gestures and all dedicated banner controls remain excluded.

Restores reliable banner navigation while an episode clip or trailer is playing. A normal click anywhere on the active banner now explicitly opens the owning series or movie and safely stops the preview stream first, while carousel arrows, page indicators, drag gestures, and the audio toggle remain independent controls.
